physics_boundaries: All results finite ideal model calculations. No experiment, no demonstrated photonic two-ququart Witting gate and no TOE.

front1_Kraus_gauge_refinement.scope: Deterministic seeded greedy local search, not global optimum in U5 or all optical meshes.

front2_two_photons.input: two indistinguishable photons in disjoint blocks of four optical modes each
front2_two_photons.deterministic_no_bunching_theorem: If no bunching for all 16 logical basis inputs, 8x8 passive U is local A⊕B or anti-block-swap, hence non-entangling up to local SWAP.
front2_two_photons.caveat: Postselection at output consumes the two data photons, not a nondestructive herald or universal entangling quantum gate. Assumes only 8 occupied modes and no ancillary photons, nonlinearities or active feedback.

front3_pump_pair.tested_chart_automorphism_subgroup: all 24 GF4 coordinate permutations (S4), generated by coordinate rearrangements
front3_pump_pair.caveat: Nonlocal pair-creation term explicitly uses P24, although no initially charged 24D reference state is needed. Does not derive a local gauge force.

independently_executed_monte_carlo.NOTE: These independent sandbox Monte Carlo runs used a different random stream order from committed module; they are qualitative crosschecks, not byte-identical expected repo certificate values.

front4_detector_drift.caveat: Worst-case linear response at uniform baseline, with drift RMS defined over resolved labels. It can fake hidden bias even with arbitrarily many photons. Simple ratio estimator not profile-likelihood efficient; prior Fisher conclusions only local ideal-nuisance model.

front5_gate_OSR.note: Applies to rank2 operator-Schmidt elementary controlled phase, not automatically to the specific nonlocal content of an arbitrary 2026 experimental qudit CPF.

external_2026_comparator.paper: Heralded high-dimensional photon–photon quantum gate, Nature Photonics 20 (2026) 460–467
external_2026_comparator.caveat: Different gate, encoding and herald protocol; no direct process fidelity comparison without full characterization.
